name: print-social-white-grid-card-month-in-review-calendar-polaroid-slide
title: Month in Review Calendar with Polaroids
whatItIs: A portrait carousel cover with a blue and black headline 'Month in review: Linkedist style' with a rocket emoji, a calendar grid with pinned polaroid photos in blue and pink frames, sticky notes, handwritten notes and series chrome with a slide counter.
whatItMeans: Photos pinned to a calendar make a recap feel tactile and personal, and blue with pink adds cheer.
techniques: Polaroid-style photos pinned on a calendar
Sticky notes and red pins as details
Series chrome with counter and tags

vocabulary.definition: A photo with a thick bottom border like an instant print.
A red pin graphic holding items to a board.
A first slide summarising a period.
